what.title: What we do
what.body: We run four kinds of events each term. Students from every department can join all of them.

items.workshop: Hands-on sessions where you bring your laptop and build something from start to finish.
items.tech_talk: Talks where people from the industry share their experience and projects.
items.summit: Large gatherings that bring many speakers and sessions together.
items.trip: Visits to tech company offices to meet their teams where they work.

teams.title: {teams} teams, {members} people
teams.body: Each team works on its own projects and workshops throughout the term. Each dot is a person.
